_help: Usual pay-as-you-go prices (no subscription, incl. VAT) of the big French networks, used only for chargers whose operator publishes no readable price in the national IRVE file. Shown with a ~ and the range, never as the charger's own price. Ranges are low-high across the sources checked; dc applies from 50 kW (or dc_fast from 100 kW when given), ac below. 'public': the network's stations are open to all even when the file says 'Accès réservé'. Re-check every few months: sources below.

networks.name: Tesla Supercharger
networks.note: Set per station and time of day in the Tesla app.
